    Lemma 2.5 for an Artin algebra #

    lem:strict-radical-layers (graded-category.tex): "Let A be any Artin algebra, let J be the radical of its category of finite-length modules […]". The manuscript assumes ordinary Auslander–Reiten theory (main.tex): every indecomposable module Y has a right almost split map E → Y, with kernel 0 (rad P → P at projectives) or a left almost split map out of the indecomposable τY (the almost split sequence). With this input (ARData), Lemma 2.5 holds in the category of finitely generated modules over an Artin algebra (strict_radical_layers_artin).

    The Krull–Schmidt input is proved: finitely generated modules are finite biproducts of indecomposables (induction on the length, decomp_module), whose endomorphism rings are local (Fitting, end_isLocalRing); the split–radical normal form and the right radical approximations then come from KrullSchmidtForm.

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.StrictLayers.strict_radical_layers_artin {A : Type u} [Ring A] (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] [Algebra R A] [Module.Finite R A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (hAR : ∀ (Y : FGModuleCat A), ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero Y → IsLocalRing (CategoryTheory.End Y) → Nonempty (ARData Y)) (n : ℕ) {U Y : FGModuleCat A} (a : U ⟶ Y) (ha : MBDVendor.QSE.CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism a) (hpert : ∀ h ∈ (Ipow 2).hom U Y, CategoryTheory.Mono (a + h)) {W : FGModuleCat A} (z : W ⟶ U) (hz : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp z a ∈ (Ipow (n + 1)).hom W Y) :
    z ∈ (Ipow n).hom W U

    Lemma 2.5 (lem:strict-radical-layers) for an Artin algebra A over a commutative Artinian ring R, in the category of finitely generated (finite-length) modules, with ordinary Auslander–Reiten theory as input (hAR, assumed by the manuscript, main.tex): for a radical monomorphism-type map a : U → Y with a + h monic for all h ∈ J²(U, Y), z ≫ a ∈ J^{n+1} implies z ∈ J^n.

    source
    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.StrictLayers.strict_radical_layers_artin_iff {A : Type u} [Ring A] (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] [Algebra R A] [Module.Finite R A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (hAR : ∀ (Y : FGModuleCat A), ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero Y → IsLocalRing (CategoryTheory.End Y) → Nonempty (ARData Y)) (n : ℕ) {U Y : FGModuleCat A} (a : U ⟶ Y) (ha : MBDVendor.QSE.CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism a) (hpert : ∀ h ∈ (Ipow 2).hom U Y, CategoryTheory.Mono (a + h)) {W : FGModuleCat A} (z : W ⟶ U) :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp z a ∈ (Ipow (n + 1)).hom W Y ↔ z ∈ (Ipow n).hom W U

    Lemma 2.5 (lem:strict-radical-layers) as stated, both directions: for a radical monomorphism a all of whose perturbations by J² are monic, z ≫ a ∈ J^{n+1} if and only if z ∈ J^n.
